TABLE.NAME: local_msgrules_course
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-course override of the site-wide student messaging mode. Only courses that differ from the default are stored.

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: Negative means no restriction. Otherwise a bitmask of who a student may still message: 1 fellow students, 2 teachers, 4 site administrators; 0 means nobody. The column default is the open value so a row created without one never silences a course.

TABLE.NAME: local_msgrules_managed
TABLE.COMMENT: The message_users_blocked rows this plugin owns, so a rebuild never touches a block a user made themselves.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The recipient - owner of the block row, matching message_users_blocked.userid.

FIELD.NAME: blockeduserid
FIELD.COMMENT: The sender kept out, matching message_users_blocked.blockeduserid.
